environment: Logged-in Chrome with the unpacked local extension
transport: Same-page X GET requests; focal post only and translation on demand. No source tabs or reply requests.

checks.case: Header only has Close and Open in X; no visible title
Only selected post rendered; no replies or reply controls
X translation from Arabic to Korean and back to original
X dark theme reflected in popup
Opening, translating and closing preserves scroll and route
No new tab on open or translation

limitations: Reply viewing, composing and reactions use Open in X.
X translation availability and target language follow the X session. Failed translations leave the original visible and can be retried.
X API or public bundle changes may require adapter updates.
